read_at_rule: Every time in this file is a fact about a past read or about CDIP's own model step. `read_at` is when this project's crawl finished reading CDIP's aggregates; `now.t` and `forecast_times` are CDIP's own. Nothing here is a clock of this app's own and no surface prints one.
nothing_derived_rule: Every value is CDIP's own, kept only where CDIP's own waveFlagPrimary says good. The only arithmetic is the unit scaling in `method.scales`, stated so no reader has to guess it. There is no band, no threshold, no comparison and no verdict.

source.publisher: CDIP Monitoring and Prediction (MOP), Scripps Institution of Oceanography, UC San Diego
source.licence_verbatim: These data may be redistributed and used without restriction.
source.what_it_is: A MODEL, not an instrument. MOP propagates the offshore wave field onto named points a few hundred metres apart along the shoreline. Every surface that prints a value from this file says model rather than measured.
source.quality_flag: CDIP publishes flag_values 1, 2, 3, 4, 9 against flag_meanings "good not_evaluated questionable bad missing", citing Ocean Data Standards, UNESCO 2013 - IOC Manuals and Guides, 54, Volume 3 Version 1. Only values flagged 1 are in this file.
source.no_device_reads_this_host: The aggregates are read by this project's pipeline. A device fetches only this file, from this project's own host, so CDIP's servers see neither a reader, nor a device, nor which spot was opened.

cdip_units.waveDp: degreeT (CDIP states it adds the magnetic declination itself)

method.forecast_rule: Every model step from the newest nowcast time forward, out to the horizon above. Steps before it are CDIP's own hindcast and are dropped: this file is what a diver is planning against, not a record of last Tuesday.
method.nowcast_rule: The newest nowcast step this point is good-flagged at, walking back. A point with nothing good in the window carries no `now` block at all — never a neighbour's value and never the previous run's carried forward.
method.gap_rule: A forecast step CDIP did not flag good is null in place, so the series stays aligned to `forecast_times` and a gap is visible as a gap.
